answer: Each agent locks quartz tokens as collateral; peers vouch for it by co-signing a sonnet-style reputation record onchain. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity attestation. A sybil farm cloning identities must lock fresh collateral per clone while its vouchers burn reputation, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts. Honest participants recoup stake and earn a meadow of attestation rewards, making genuine participation cheaper than forgery. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
